assets.prompt:
Create ONE production game sprite: the NORTH-WALL dungeon entrance, using these references.
REFERENCE 1 (dungeon screenshot): use the arched wooden door in its upper-left corner as the exact design and camera reference.
REFERENCE 2 (kit sheet): match the chunky desaturated slate-blue masonry, soft hand-painted low-resolution game shading and clear black/navy outlines. Keep detail simple enough for a 150px sprite.
Output ONLY the isolated complete doorway on a genuinely transparent background, no floor patch or surrounding wall. No text, labels, border, torches, flames, runes or glow.
Design: short rounded arch built from chunky blue-gray stone blocks; closed brown vertical wood-plank single door; two simple dark iron horizontal straps with small rivets; one iron ring handle. Restrained weathering. Stone frame must match the reference masonry, not highly detailed realistic sculpting.
Orientation NORTH: installed in the upper wall of a top-down orthogonal 2D room, doorway opening faces DOWN the screen toward the room. See front of the upright wood door and a narrow top surface on the arch stones. Bilaterally centered, no isometric diagonal vanishing point, no tilted verticals. Threshold perfectly horizontal along screen X. Object upright, symmetric overall, near square silhouette, transparent padding 8% around the complete sprite.
Keep this faithful to the original door, but omit the two torches and all purple lighting.

Game asset directional variant of the exact SAME small arched dungeon entrance. Reference1 is its NORTH/front sprite: preserve slate-blue chunky stone blocks, brown wood door with simple dark iron fittings, clean painted videogame edges, low detail that reads at 150px. Reference2 shows the target orthogonal top-down dungeon kit and lighting. Output ONE isolated transparent PNG sprite only, full object with clear transparent margin, no floor patch, no room/wall extension, no labels, no torches, no glow, no UI. IMPORTANT: fixed camera high above looking toward screen-top. This is an upright entrance installed in a wall, never a flat wooden hatch. Re-project the object in world space for the requested orientation; DO NOT rotate a flat front sprite in image space. No isometric diagonal floor grid or vanishing point.
SOUTH/BOTTOM WALL VARIANT. The doorway is placed along a horizontal bottom boundary of a room; the room interior is ABOVE it on the screen. The entrance's interior-facing front points UP, away from the viewer. Show its rear/outside surface and the top thickness of the blue stone arch, with the wooden door BACK visible below the arch. The threshold runs exactly horizontally. Rear of door uses same brown vertical planks and plain iron braces, no ring handle on back. Broad squat arch, same scale as reference, darker near-facing rear stones. A rear elevation viewed from above, upright, never upside down. No floating canopy. Stone feet align at same Y.

A production sprite for a LEFT/WEST wall doorway in an orthogonal top-down 2D dungeon game.
Reference1 is the exact dungeon stone style and camera to match. Reference2 supplies ONLY the material palette of this doorway (blue stone, brown wood, black iron), NOT its frontal orientation.
CRUCIAL CAMERA: genuinely OVERHEAD / PLAN VIEW, looking down onto the doorway cutaway. The wall runs screen TOP to BOTTOM. The room is on screen RIGHT; travel through the entrance is screen LEFT to RIGHT. You see the TOP SURFACES of two chunky stone jambs at the NORTH and SOUTH ends, with the closed wooden door seen nearly EDGE-ON as a narrow vertical brown strip running between them. Do not show a vertical upright arched door facade. Do not show a ring handle. No top-center arch peak. No tall upright pillars. No elevation view, no squeeze of a front door.
Geometry: an elongated rectangular module about 1 unit wide by 2.7 units tall, aligned exactly to screen axes. At the top and bottom are square/short rectangular caps of blue stone. Between them is a narrow north-south wooden door slab viewed from above, seated in a blue stone rebate along the OUTER LEFT edge. The inside RIGHT side shows a very small recessed dark threshold gap, transparent beyond the silhouette. The stone top surfaces are broad and clearly visible, like the 'Mur gauche' tile in reference1. All long edges exactly vertical, all cross edges exactly horizontal; no isometric diamond projection, no diagonal perspective or vanishing point.
Style: simple chunky soft-painted slate-blue masonry, navy crevices, restrained light blue highlights upper-left, like reference1. Few large blocks, flat readable mobile game asset at 52 x 144 px. Tiny hints of iron brackets on the narrow wood edge, no decorative detail. This is a wall INSERT, not a freestanding upright object.
Output one complete isolated sprite with genuinely transparent background, no floor, room, labels, torches, cast shadow, glow, UI or other objects. Preserve transparent padding around the full module.

Edit the supplied overhead LEFT/WEST-wall doorway sprite to create the RIGHT/EAST-wall counterpart. Keep the OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW exactly: two broad square stone cap surfaces at the screen-top and screen-bottom, straight elongated stone rebate between, thin brown edge of the closed door with two small dark iron brackets.
Reverse only its left/right structure: the long blue stone rebate must be on the RIGHT / outside, the narrow wooden slab and recessed inner edge on the LEFT / room side. Same block count, same silhouette, same scale, same navy/slate-blue colors and simple painted texture. Preserve restrained illumination from upper-left after reversing the structure.
No upright arch, no raised arched peak, no frontal wooden door, no ring handle, no diagonal or isometric projection. All long edges screen-vertical; end caps horizontal. Keep this reading as a top-down wall insert.
Genuine transparent background, same framing and source proportions as the input, no floor, ground shadow, glow, labels or extra objects.
